query.sql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT json_extract(value, '$.dataset') AS dataset,
         json_extract(value, '$.setting') AS setting,
         json_extract(value, '$.seed') AS seed,
         json_extract(value, '$.macro_auc') AS auc,
         json_extract(value, '$.macro_logloss') AS logloss
  FROM json_each(:runs_json)
  WHERE json_extract(value, '$.eligible') = 1
)
SELECT dataset, COUNT(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN 1 END) AS sisa_seed_count,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'baseline' AND seed = 20262027 THEN auc END) AS baseline_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262027 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262027_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262028 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262028_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262029 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262029_auc,
       mean(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN auc END) AS sisa_auc_mean,
       sample_sd(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN auc END) AS sisa_auc_sample_sd,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'baseline' AND seed = 20262027 THEN logloss END) AS baseline_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262027 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262027_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262028 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262028_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262029 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262029_logloss,
       mean(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN logloss END) AS sisa_logloss_mean,
       sample_sd(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN logloss END) AS sisa_logloss_sample_sd
FROM runs
GROUP BY dataset
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN 1 END) = 3;

query.sql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT json_extract(r.value, '$.dataset') AS dataset,
         json_extract(r.value, '$.setting') AS setting,
         json_extract(r.value, '$.seed') AS seed, m.key AS label,
         json_extract(m.value, '$.AUC') AS auc,
         json_extract(m.value, '$.logloss') AS logloss
  FROM json_each(:runs_json) AS r,
       json_each(json_extract(r.value, '$.metrics')) AS m
  WHERE json_extract(r.value, '$.eligible') = 1
)
SELECT dataset, label, COUNT(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN 1 END) AS sisa_seed_count,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'baseline' AND seed = 20262027 THEN auc END) AS baseline_20262027_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262027 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262027_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262028 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262028_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262029 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262029_auc,
       mean(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN auc END) AS sisa_auc_mean,
       sample_sd(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN auc END) AS sisa_auc_sample_sd,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'baseline' AND seed = 20262027 THEN logloss END) AS baseline_20262027_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262027 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262027_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262028 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262028_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262029 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262029_logloss,
       mean(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN logloss END) AS sisa_logloss_mean,
       sample_sd(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN logloss END) AS sisa_logloss_sample_sd
FROM runs
GROUP BY dataset, label
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN 1 END) = 3;

query.sql:
SELECT
  CASE json_extract(value, '$.dataset')
    WHEN 'QK_Video_Action' THEN 'QK-Video'
    WHEN 'KuaiRand_Video_Action' THEN 'KuaiRand'
    WHEN 'TencentGR_10M_Action' THEN 'TAAC-25'
    WHEN 'MerRec_Action' THEN 'MerRec' END AS dataset_name,
  json_extract(value, '$.seed') AS seed,
  json_extract(value, '$.job_task_id') AS job_task_id,
  json_extract(value, '$.attempt') AS attempt,
  json_extract(value, '$.state') AS state,
  json_extract(value, '$.exit_code') AS exit_code,
  json_extract(value, '$.world_size') || '×H100 / 每卡' || json_extract(value, '$.per_gpu_batch') AS layout,
  json_extract(value, '$.global_batch') AS global_batch,
  json_extract(value, '$.run_id') AS run_id
FROM json_each(:runs_json)
WHERE json_extract(value, '$.historical') = 0
  AND json_extract(value, '$.eligible') = 1
ORDER BY CAST(key AS INTEGER);

    json_extract(value, '$.dataset') AS dataset,
    json_extract(value, '$.label') AS label,
    json_extract(value, '$.baseline_auc') AS baseline_auc,

    json_extract(value, '$.baseline_logloss') AS baseline_logloss,
    json_extract(value, '$.sisa_logloss') AS sisa_logloss,
    json_extract(value, '$.source') AS source,
    json_extract(value, '$.delta_auc') AS delta_auc,
    json_extract(value, '$.delta_logloss') AS delta_logloss,

blocks.body: # UniRank SISA 实验总报告：32-task strict 与 38-task HPC3 扩展

## 历史诊断档案与当前论文证据范围

本报告保留早期 70-task / 35-cell 混合矩阵，相关总量、均值、极值与解读均为历史诊断记录，不作为当前论文证据。当前正式范围仅为 HiFormer、HyFormer、RankMixer、Zenith × QK-Video、KuaiRand、TAAC-25、MerRec。下方 Accepted 16-cell 的 68 条逐动作结果与 Diagnostic 79 条记录分别展示；完整论文汇总采用独立报告 sisa_paper_report/report.md。

## 2026-09-20补充：OneTrans四数据集三种子已齐

**QK-Video、KuaiRand、TAAC-25、MerRec均已取得20262027／20262028／20262029三个SISA种子的最终Test结果。** MerRec重提任务636370_9于15:58:35成功结束，COMPLETED / 0:0；八个新增逻辑任务全部补齐。

以下是独立OneTrans诊断记录，不计入accepted 16-cell论文统计，也不改变原70-task历史矩阵。baseline仅有历史seed20262027一次。AUC越高越好，LogLoss越低越好；先对每轮各标签等权，再对三个SISA种子求均值与样本SD（ddof=1）。三点统计不能当作三轮配对效应或显著性证据。

## TAAC-25的AUC与LogLoss方向不同

QK的平均AUC与历史baseline接近。KuaiRand、MerRec的三个SISA种子宏AUC均高于历史baseline，宏LogLoss均更低。**TAAC-25平均AUC为0.857380，高于baseline的0.855624，但平均LogLoss升至0.040551，baseline为0.033613。** 后两轮LogLoss分别为0.042081和0.046171，应同时保留这一负面结果。MerRec三种子AUC为**0.815621 ± 0.002604**，宏LogLoss为**0.081090 ± 0.000758**。

## 最终任务与协议：只重提了MerRec缺失的一个种子

原630948_9在训练前的NCCL barrier报CUDA 999错误，29秒退出，没有Test指标；成功重提636370_9保留seed20262029、四卡和冻结配置，仅改为attempt2并避开原报错节点。Taobao此前按用户要求取消，不属于本轮四数据集补齐范围。

完成记录核对了Slurm状态、outcome返回码、精确完成标记、manifest身份及有效配置、两份日志的最终Test指标一致性，以及对应布局的数据覆盖。16次有效运行包括4次历史baseline与12次SISA，共68行标签指标。QK／MerRec后两轮采用4×8192，KuaiRand／TAAC-25采用2×16384；global batch均为32768，训练1 epoch。

## 三点波动包含布局与尾批覆盖差异

历史seed27均为四卡。KuaiRand与TAAC-25后两轮改用两卡，测试覆盖分别较历史四卡少16,384和49,152个样本，train／valid尾批也有差异。因此相同global batch不保证逐rank随机流或评测集合相同，三种子SD不能解释为纯随机种子方差；新增H100与历史GPU之间的环境差异也需保留。

## OneTrans逐动作明细：保留baseline、三个seed、均值与SD

以下分别展示17个动作标签的AUC和LogLoss，供核对宏平均与不同动作方向。数值来自已完成的最终Test段；单个历史baseline没有被复制成三次独立baseline。

## 技术摘要

截至 2026-08-25，项目已完成 **70/70 个训练元素**：由 DIGAI Lab 迁入的 32-task strict 矩阵与 HPC3/ACD 上新完成的 38-task expansion 矩阵。两部分合计形成 147 个 baseline/SISA 标签配对。strict 的平均 ΔAUC 为 **+0.002115**；expansion 的平均 ΔAUC 为 **+0.003802**，48/71 个标签提升、23/71 个标签下降。所有 71 个 expansion baseline 都满足相对仓库内 UniRank official benchmark 的 `|ΔAUC| ≤ 0.01` 验收规则。

## 新增结果通过 UniRank baseline 复现门槛

38-task expansion 覆盖 19 个 baseline 单元和 71 个标签，**71/71** 个本地 baseline AUC 与仓库内 official benchmark 的绝对差均不超过 0.01。最大偏差为 **0.009366**，出现在 UltraHSTU–KuaiRand `is_click`（official 0.774418，本地 0.765052），仍在验收范围内。

## Expansion 总体正向，但收益并非均匀分布

19 个模型×数据集单元中 13 个平均 ΔAUC 为正。最强单元是 UltraHSTU–MerRec（+0.012726）、HyFormer–MerRec（+0.012394）和 HiFormer–TencentGR（+0.011561）；主要回退是 HyFormer–Taobao（−0.015343）。标签级最大提升为 UltraHSTU–KuaiRand `is_click`（+0.027940），最大下降为 HyFormer–Taobao `cart`（−0.026251）。

## 完整矩阵解读

矩阵横轴是模型、纵轴是数据集，35 个单元格全部来自现有实验记录，并给出该模型×数据集内标签级平均 ΔAUC（×10⁻³）。绿色和 `+` 表示 SISA 高于 baseline，红色和 `−` 表示下降，颜色深浅按全矩阵最大绝对变化对称映射。蓝色内框标记由 DIGAI Lab 迁入的 16 个 strict 单元；无内框的 19 个单元来自 HPC3 expansion。完整矩阵中 25/35 个单元为正，最明显回退是 DIGAI Lab strict 记录中的 HiFormer–Taobao（−0.025167）。

## Strict 结果回顾：KuaiRand 与 MerRec 较强，Taobao 风险最明显

原 32-task strict 矩阵覆盖 16 个模型×数据集单元和 76 个标签配对，平均 ΔAUC **+0.002115**，12/16 个单元为正。KuaiRand 和 MerRec 在四个模型上的单元均值全部为正；最明显的退化是 HiFormer–Taobao（−0.025167），因此不能把总体正均值解释为所有模型和数据集都稳定提升。

## Strict 图表解读

横轴同样采用单元内标签级平均 ΔAUC，便于与 expansion 分布对照；精确数值及标签提升数见下表。

## Accepted 16-cell 证据：从数据集总体下钻到动作类别

下列 4 张表展示 accepted 范围内的 **68 个模型×数据集×动作类别配对**，不再只看模型×数据集均值。QK-Video 包含 `click/follow/like/share`，KuaiRand 包含 6 类行为，MerRec 包含 `Like/Cart/Offer/Checkout/Purchase`，TencentGR 包含 `is_click/is_conversion`。每行同时给出 baseline、SISA、ΔAUC 和 ΔLogloss；运行来源列只用于说明数据归档位置，不改变 accepted 状态。

## Diagnostic 附录：额外模型与 Taobao 的逐动作记录

以下 **79 个模型×数据集×动作类别配对** 不参与论文汇总或实验结论，仅用于运行诊断和历史追溯。它们与上方 68 条 accepted 证据保持独立。

## 范围、协议与完成定义

DIGAI Lab 迁入的 strict 矩阵为 OneTrans、HiFormer、RankMixer、Zenith × QK-Video、KuaiRand、Taobao、MerRec × baseline/SISA；HPC3 expansion 增加四个原模型的 TencentGR 配对，以及 UniMixer、HyFormer、UltraHSTU 在五个数据集上的配对。两部分组合后覆盖完整的 7 模型 × 5 数据集矩阵。两部分都采用每卡 batch 8192、global batch 32768、1 epoch、seed 20262027、BF16 与 blocked DDP。Expansion 每个训练元素使用 4 × H100 80GB，并要求 Slurm `COMPLETED`、exit code `0:0`、协议字段完整、有限测试指标、零错误与完成标记。

## 历史 strict 迁移结论

DIGAI Lab 的 strict 核心证据包已迁入当前 HPC3 项目：完整实验报告、机器可读结果、32 份 checkpoint 日志和 32 份最终 Slurm 日志，迁移审计为 75/75 文件、253,466,283 bytes。旧训练流程在测试后删除了 strict 权重，因此这部分历史证据不含 32 份正式 `.model`。

## Strict 历史迁移包构成

32 份 checkpoint 日志保存训练、最佳模型加载、测试指标和 checkpoint 删除记录；32 份最终 Slurm 日志保存资源、协议头、完成标记与进程级输出。下表仅描述已完成的 HPC01→HPC3 strict 迁移包，不代表当前 expansion 结果清单。

## Checkpoint 边界

当前已完成的 strict 与 expansion 日志都显示：测试加载最佳模型后，旧训练流程删除了对应 `.model`，所以这 70 个历史训练元素目前只有指标日志，没有可恢复的正式权重。项目现已把后续逻辑改为软删除：最佳 checkpoint 留在数据集目录，其他 checkpoint 移入 `checkpoints/<dataset_id>/archive/<run_id>/<session_id>/`；该策略只对后续新训练生效，不会自动恢复历史权重。

## 历史迁移说明

Strict 迁移已完成，不应再次从 HPC01 重跑 rsync。`migration_files.txt` 保留的是迁移当时 HPC01 源目录的 75 文件清单，部分路径仍是整理前名称；它用于审计追溯，不再作为当前目录的执行清单。

## 当前结果快速校验

在 HPC3 项目根目录使用 uv 管理的环境检查两组最终 run 表：

```bash
uv run python - <<'PY'
import csv
strict = list(csv.DictReader(open('experiments/sisa_native_strict/results/runs.csv')))
expansion = list(csv.DictReader(open('experiments/sisa_expansion_acd/results/runs.csv')))
assert len(strict) == 32 and all(r['complete'] == 'True' for r in strict)
assert len(expansion) == 38 and all(r['complete'] == 'True' for r in expansion)
print('complete=70/70')
PY
```

## 结果汇总方法

每个逻辑单元由同一模型、数据集和协议下的 baseline/SISA 两个独立训练元素组成。标签级 ΔAUC 与 ΔLogloss 均定义为 SISA 减 baseline；报告先保留标签级配对，再在模型×数据集单元内等权平均。Strict 的 152 行任务指标形成 76 个标签配对；expansion 的 142 行任务指标形成 71 个标签配对。Expansion baseline 另与仓库内 official benchmark 逐标签比较，以 `|ΔAUC| ≤ 0.01` 作为复现门槛。失败或被纠正配置替代的旧 job 不进入最终 run 映射。

## 局限性与稳健性边界

两组实验都只有一个 seed、一个 epoch，因此结果是受控点估计，不提供方差、置信区间或统计显著性。DIGAI Lab 迁移的 strict 记录使用 RTX 4090/L40S 配对，HPC3 expansion 使用 4 × H100 80GB；协议字段一致，但硬件与论文 H20 环境不同。完整矩阵用于覆盖总览，不能把两种来源视为完全同质的硬件实验。UltraHSTU 的三个 SISA recovery 关闭了外围 TorchDynamo 编译以绕过 H100 Triton 资源限制，模型、稀疏 mask、数据、batch、精度、seed 与 DDP 协议保持不变。

## 建议下一步

1. 优先对 UltraHSTU–MerRec、HyFormer–MerRec 与 HyFormer–Taobao 做多 seed 复跑，验证最强收益和主要回退是否稳定。
2. 将通信、分片、聚合和编译恢复策略拆成独立消融实验，结果放入 `experiments/ablations/`，不要覆盖当前 70-task 正式矩阵。
3. 需要推理或继续训练的单元按新 checkpoint 软删除策略重跑，并同时核对 best 权重与 `archive/` 中间权重。
4. 后续总报告继续从 `runs.csv`、标签级配对表和 baseline 审计表生成，保持任务映射与异常恢复可追溯。

## 后续研究问题

- SISA 的正向收益主要来自通信机制本身，还是与模型容量、序列长度或数据集标签稀疏度交互？
- HyFormer–Taobao 的回退是否跨 seed 稳定，具体由 `cart` 标签还是多任务耦合主导？
- UltraHSTU 关闭外围编译后的吞吐与显存代价是多少，是否影响扩展到更长序列？
- 保留所有 checkpoint 后，最佳验证 checkpoint 与最终测试 AUC 的排序是否稳定？

query.sql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT json_extract(value, '$.dataset') AS dataset,
         json_extract(value, '$.setting') AS setting,
         json_extract(value, '$.seed') AS seed,
         json_extract(value, '$.macro_auc') AS auc,
         json_extract(value, '$.macro_logloss') AS logloss
  FROM json_each(:runs_json)
  WHERE json_extract(value, '$.eligible') = 1
)
SELECT dataset, COUNT(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN 1 END) AS sisa_seed_count,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'baseline' AND seed = 20262027 THEN auc END) AS baseline_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262027 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262027_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262028 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262028_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262029 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262029_auc,
       mean(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN auc END) AS sisa_auc_mean,
       sample_sd(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN auc END) AS sisa_auc_sample_sd,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'baseline' AND seed = 20262027 THEN logloss END) AS baseline_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262027 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262027_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262028 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262028_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262029 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262029_logloss,
       mean(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN logloss END) AS sisa_logloss_mean,
       sample_sd(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN logloss END) AS sisa_logloss_sample_sd
FROM runs
GROUP BY dataset
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN 1 END) = 3;

WITH runs AS (
  SELECT json_extract(r.value, '$.dataset') AS dataset,
         json_extract(r.value, '$.setting') AS setting,
         json_extract(r.value, '$.seed') AS seed, m.key AS label,
         json_extract(m.value, '$.AUC') AS auc,
         json_extract(m.value, '$.logloss') AS logloss
  FROM json_each(:runs_json) AS r,
       json_each(json_extract(r.value, '$.metrics')) AS m
  WHERE json_extract(r.value, '$.eligible') = 1
)
SELECT dataset, label, COUNT(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN 1 END) AS sisa_seed_count,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'baseline' AND seed = 20262027 THEN auc END) AS baseline_20262027_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262027 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262027_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262028 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262028_auc,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262029 THEN auc END) AS sisa_20262029_auc,
       mean(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN auc END) AS sisa_auc_mean,
       sample_sd(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN auc END) AS sisa_auc_sample_sd,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'baseline' AND seed = 20262027 THEN logloss END) AS baseline_20262027_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262027 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262027_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262028 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262028_logloss,
       MAX(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' AND seed = 20262029 THEN logloss END) AS sisa_20262029_logloss,
       mean(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN logloss END) AS sisa_logloss_mean,
       sample_sd(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN logloss END) AS sisa_logloss_sample_sd
FROM runs
GROUP BY dataset, label
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN setting = 'sisa' THEN 1 END) = 3;

SELECT
  CASE json_extract(value, '$.dataset')
    WHEN 'QK_Video_Action' THEN 'QK-Video'
    WHEN 'KuaiRand_Video_Action' THEN 'KuaiRand'
    WHEN 'TencentGR_10M_Action' THEN 'TAAC-25'
    WHEN 'MerRec_Action' THEN 'MerRec' END AS dataset_name,
  json_extract(value, '$.seed') AS seed,
  json_extract(value, '$.job_task_id') AS job_task_id,
  json_extract(value, '$.attempt') AS attempt,
  json_extract(value, '$.state') AS state,
  json_extract(value, '$.exit_code') AS exit_code,
  json_extract(value, '$.world_size') || '×H100 / 每卡' || json_extract(value, '$.per_gpu_batch') AS layout,
  json_extract(value, '$.global_batch') AS global_batch,
  json_extract(value, '$.run_id') AS run_id
FROM json_each(:runs_json)
WHERE json_extract(value, '$.historical') = 0
  AND json_extract(value, '$.eligible') = 1
ORDER BY CAST(key AS INTEGER);

-- SQLite presentation query. Bind :action_rows_json to the complete joined
-- action rows produced by scripts/build_sisa_overall_report.py from the
-- strict metrics and expansion paired_summary CSVs. Preserve input ordering.
SELECT
    json_extract(value, '$.model') AS model,
    json_extract(value, '$.dataset') AS dataset,
    json_extract(value, '$.label') AS label,
    json_extract(value, '$.baseline_auc') AS baseline_auc,
    json_extract(value, '$.sisa_auc') AS sisa_auc,
    json_extract(value, '$.baseline_logloss') AS baseline_logloss,
    json_extract(value, '$.sisa_logloss') AS sisa_logloss,
    json_extract(value, '$.source') AS source,
    json_extract(value, '$.delta_auc') AS delta_auc,
    json_extract(value, '$.delta_logloss') AS delta_logloss,
    json_extract(value, '$.evidence_scope') AS evidence_scope
FROM json_each(:action_rows_json)
ORDER BY CAST(key AS INTEGER);
